name: Virtue USD
oneLiner: VUSD is Virtue Money's CDP dollar on IOTA, minted by borrowing against overcollateralized IOTA and stIOTA positions with liquidation defending the peg.
collateral: Overcollateralized IOTA, stIOTA, and IBTC (bridged BTC) positions backing VUSD debt inside the Virtue Money protocol
pegMechanism: CDP-style mint: users borrow VUSD against IOTA or stIOTA collateral and repay debt to unlock collateral, with liquidation and redemption mechanics supporting the U.S. dollar peg

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Virtue is a crypto-collateralized protocol, but the IOTA deployment is not yet represented in Pharos contract metadata and available sources do not prove the absence of admin or pause surfaces.

mintAuthority.summary: VUSD is a Liquity-V2-friendly-fork CDP on IOTA EVM: users open overcollateralized positions in IOTA/stIOTA to mint VUSD at user-set interest rates, with liquidations and redemptions defending the peg; future collateral beyond IOTA/stIOTA was not independently verified.

controls.label: Virtue Money borrower-operations / branch contracts (Liquity V2 fork)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by overcollateralized CDPs across IOTA/stIOTA branches with user-set interest rates, per the Liquity V2 multi-collateral design.
controls.evidence: Virtue docs describe VUSD as minted by opening overcollateralized CDPs using IOTA/stIOTA on a Liquity V2 friendly fork on IOTA EVM with user-set rates, flash minting, and liquidation/redemption peg defense.

controls.label: Virtue Money admin (multisig)
controls.evidence: This coin's metadata marks governanceQuality as multisig; Liquity V2 forks add new collateral branches via an admin, and IOTA contract metadata is not indexed, so owner renouncement could not be verified and an admin surface is assumed.

review.evidence: Virtue Money documentation and launch coverage describe VUSD as a Liquity-V2-friendly-fork CDP on IOTA EVM minted against IOTA/stIOTA; IBTC collateral was not supported by reviewed official sources. The IOTA deployment is not indexed in Pharos contract metadata and owner renouncement / admin wiring could not be independently verified, so a governed-CDP classification is used rather than immutable.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the on-chain owner/admin of the Virtue Money core/branch contracts on IOTA EVM and whether ownership is renounced (which would warrant immutable-user-collateralized).
Confirm whether a separate governance token / DAO exists beyond a team multisig.
